response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rentals FROM rental WHERE CAST(return_date AS TEXT) >= '2005-07-13 08:35:51' AND CAST(return_date AS TEXT) <= '2005-08-09 05:58:16'

assumptions.assumption: The sum of per-customer counts equals the total number of qualifying rentals, so I count rows directly instead of grouping by customer_id first. Rentals with a NULL return_date are excluded because they fail the comparison.
return_date is stored as text in the form 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', so a text comparison matches chronological order. The request says to compare as text.
